name: Vaseline Intensive Care Cocoa Radiant Body Gel Oil 200ml International
description:
Product details of Vaseline Intensive Care Cocoa Radiant Body Gel Oil – 200ml / Vitamin B3 Body Oil 200ml-400ml (International)

Product Type: Body Gel Oil / Moisturizing Body Oil

Size: 200ml / 400ml

Origin: Made in Poland

Key Features:

Pure Cocoa Butter & Replenishing Oils: Moisturizes dry skin and promotes healthy, glowing skin

Locks in Moisture: Microdroplets of Vaseline® Jelly help retain hydration for long-lasting softness

Non-Greasy Formula: Rich, lightweight texture absorbs quickly

Revitalizes Dry, Dull Skin: Helps heal and nourish skin for radiant results

Daily Use: Suitable for dry and dull skin types, ideal as a daily body lotion
